evidence.environment: Fleet source repository, deep-review workflow, opus lanes
evidence.source_reference: GATE-001 branch 2026-08-09/10: six deep-review rounds (5 -> 2 -> 1 -> 1 -> 1 -> 1 criticals), roughly 1.5M subagent tokens, rounds 3-6 criticals each located in the previous round's fix sentences; zero behavioral contracts run during the loop

expected_behavior: A prose-behavior change gets at most two deep-review rounds; further criticals in fix-introduced sentences route to a live behavioral-contract run or an executed verification pass, and a third static round requires an explicit operator ruling.
observation: Statically reviewing prose that governs hypothetical agent behavior did not converge: after round two, every critical was in sentences the previous fix introduced, because natural-language rules have unbounded hypothetical attack surface and each rewrite mints the next round's findings. The instruments that actually closed questions were an infrastructure fix (container engine) and, in principle, the behavioral-contract runs that were authored but never executed during the loop.
